summary: The note argues that diversification is a necessity for SME survival and stability in the post-2023 business environment. It covers vertical, horizontal, technological, geographic, collaborative, ESG-driven and customer-centric diversification, with dated examples from named companies and experts. It also warns that over-diversification can spread resources too thin and requires planning aligned with core competencies.
one_line: Overview of diversification tactics SMEs use for stability and growth, with examples, plus the risk of over-diversification.
key_facts: A Global SME Alliance report published October 15, 2023 found that businesses implementing diversification strategies were 35% more likely to report stable or increased profits during economic downturns.
Mark Sanders, an SME consultant, said in a November 4, 2023 keynote that diversification should be seen as building a portfolio of business activities that complement and reinforce each other.
Vertical diversification means integrating supply chain processes, such as an artisanal coffee maker purchasing plantations to control raw materials.
Horizontal diversification means adding complementary products or services, such as a coffee business launching biodegradable coffee pods compatible with popular coffee machines.
Emily Johnson, CEO of CraftBrews, said in a September 22, 2023 interview that producing hop-infused bakery items tapped a new market and balanced revenue streams.
Kevin Zhao, founder of Z-Tech Solutions, said on December 3, 2023 that using blockchain for inventory systems enhanced security and attracted clients from the fintech sector.
Chic Threads, a boutique clothing store, announced on January 6, 2024 a 47% increase in online sales after extending shipping to 10 additional countries.

GreenTech Innovations and BuildSmart Construction announced a collaboration on February 9, 2024, combining renewable energy and sustainable building expertise to bid on government eco-friendly infrastructure contracts.
Suzanne Vega, founder of EarthSafe, launched a line of eco-friendly household cleaners on April 15, 2024 to appeal to sustainability-conscious consumers.
Customer-centric diversification develops new offerings from customer feedback, market research and predictive analytics, e.g. a catering service adding event planning or cooking classes.
Over-diversification, such as spreading resources too thin or entering areas with no strategic fit, can cause confusion, inefficiencies and financial losses.
SMEs are responding to over-diversification risk by establishing dedicated teams or hiring experts to guide diversification.
